assumptions.text: Proposed future betting and subscription items are not compiled as hard requirements in this spec.
The current live default profile is treated as an accepted assumption only until changed by a promotion decision.
Future odds data, if introduced, remains limited to paper-trading research until a separate accepted specification exists.

gaps.text: REQ.budget-bound: when the available budget is missing, the workflow must not infer a private account balance and must require an explicit operator-provided budget; supported as an explicit runtime constraint but not fully represented by the available invariant set.

REQ.exploratory-evidence-labeling: exploratory fixture evidence must remain labeled as research-only; the specification does not provide a supported runtime contract beyond the exclusion of strict no-leakage production claims.

CONSTRAINT.no-guarantee-claims: The specification forbids guarantee claims on recommendation, report, subscription, and advice surfaces; only the explicit no-guarantee prohibition is supported here, and no additional structured product capability is specified.
